conventions.alpha: BLEND for glass/ice/wing swatches (palette a<1); MASK (cutoff 0.5) for *_tex foliage materials
conventions.materials: material names are palette swatch ids (palette.json); vertex COLOR_0 carries baked AO x height gradient and multiplies base colour
conventions.pivot: base-centre on the ground unless the asset says otherwise (collectibles: centre, icicles: top)
conventions.units: 1 gu (game unit) = 1 engine metre = 3.33 mm of the real miniature world; the robot is 1.5 gu (5 mm) tall

formats.canonical: GLB, uncompressed geometry, embedded PNG/JPEG only (loads with the current gltf crate features)
formats.web: tools/revamp_art/pack_web.sh -> EXT_meshopt_compression + KHR_mesh_quantization + KHR_texture_basisu GLBs and KTX2 texture sets
